title: Search indexing pipeline
description:
Design a database-to-search index pipeline using a transactional outbox or CDC. Address ordering/versioning, retries, idempotent indexing, delete tombstones, and rebuilding the index.

Write a structured explanation. This is a transparent keyword rubric, not an AI architect or proof of a sound design. Check every tradeoff yourself; a rubric pass demonstrates coverage only.

reference.text:
Design a database-to-search index pipeline using a transactional outbox or CDC. Address ordering/versioning, retries, idempotent indexing, delete tombstones, and rebuilding the index.
A dual write can lose the search update if one system succeeds and the other fails. An outbox/CDC stream makes changes replayable, but consumers must still handle duplicates.
outbox; version; retry; idempoten; tombstone; rebuild
